name: @dsh-android/bundle-android
description: DSH-Android profile bundle and engine entry (main.mjs): layered over dsh-base + dsh-sdk-app; trims desktop/web/experimental rows, runs approval-only without an OS sandbox, mounts the device, guard, mode, account and extensions plugins, dsh's plugin manager and market, and the dormant llm-service-lite row for third-party models.
